description: Create a Compliance Setting. projectId comes from your credentials. Fields: oneuptime_describe_resource.

framework.description: The compliance framework this setting changes for the resource: GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, LGPD or DPDP, or for a Kubernetes cluster PSS Baseline, PSS Restricted or CIS Kubernetes.

resourceId.description: The ID of the resource that turned the framework off.

resourceType.description: The kind of resource that turned the framework off: KubernetesCluster, DockerHost, PodmanHost, DatabaseServer, CloudResource or Service.

name: create_compliance_setting
title: Create Compliance Setting
